rollback_evidence: Measured on FortiGate-60F v7.6.8,build3744 on 2026-11-23 with the full admin orchestration and the cli-script safeguard: create of an IPv6 address group with one firewall address6 member, used by a disabled IPv6 firewall policy (srcaddr6), and its undo (delete) ended confirmed, and the check account showed the predicted group each time. Refused before any write: apply without the approved preview hash (fortios_object_preview_required) and the delete of the group while the policy used it (fortios_object_referenced). show full-configuration prints exclude disable (fixed). show and show full-configuration of firewall addrgrp6 equalled the output before the run. Member updates, the delete request outside an undo and the endpoint_impact rule of an enabled policy are covered by the simulated device only. A recreated group receives a new uuid. FortiOS 8.0.1 and later: refused before any write (safeguard_no_rest_inverse), verified by preview on FortiOS 8.0.2 build0251.
